marque.accroche: Your clients edit their site. You keep the code.

marketing.titre:
Your clients edit their site.
You keep the code.
marketing.sousTitre: Drop in the site you already shipped. Calque finds what can be edited, locks everything else, and hands your client an editor they understand.

une.texte: The site exactly as you shipped it. No format to follow, no convention to adopt, no refactoring.

deux.texte: Text, images, links, colours, repeatable blocks, SEO: what can be edited is detected, everything else is locked.

trois.texte: They click a heading in the preview, they type, they publish. The site is rebuilt identically with their content.

principe.titre: The source code is never modified
principe.texte: The files you upload are stored read-only. What your client changes is a content layer on top. You can ship a new design without losing a single line of their work.

pourQui.texte: You build the site. Your client updates their hours, photos and prices without calling you. Nobody breaks anything.

connexion.sousTitre: Enter your email address. We'll send you a sign-in link — no password to remember.
connexion.modeDev: No email delivery key is configured: the sign-in link will appear in the server logs.

verifier.texte: We've sent you a sign-in link. It's valid for 24 hours and works only once.
verifier.aide: Nothing came through? Check your spam folder, then try again.

erreur.lienExpire: This link has expired or has already been used. Request a new one.
erreur.acces: Access was denied. Contact the agency that manages your site.
erreur.generique: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.

tableauDeBord.videAide: Upload the ZIP of a delivered site to get started. Ingestion arrives in the next stage of the product.
